v.why: Adding an input-to-output residual where none exists gives large gains (exps 61, 91), far more than when it replaces a conv or pool.
Removing an existing edge-3 residual consistently costs several points, especially on ImageNet16 (exps 12, 72, 82).
Without the edge-3 shortcut, edge 5 is a critical path to the output and cutting it can collapse accuracy (exp 64).
With edge 3 absent, removing edge 0 starves the downstream nodes and can disconnect the cell (exps 65, 95).
Adding a parametric direct path where none exists helps much more than swapping conv in for a skip, which hurts (exps 62 vs 11, 81).
Replacing a parameter-free pool on the first edge with a 3x3 conv adds substantial capacity (exp 46), more than replacing other ops.
Avg-pool on the final edge hurts, so replacing it with a conv recovers a lot of accuracy (exp 43).
Swapping the last conv for a pool removes key capacity on the main output path (exps 10, 80), worse than swapping out a 1x1 conv or none.
When no input-output residual exists, a skip on edge 5 gives the cell an easier gradient path (exps 63, 93), unlike when edge 3 already provides one (exp 73).
Replacing the conv on edge 1 with a pool removes capacity from the node-2 branch (exps 9, 79), unlike replacing none or a 1x1 conv (exps 59, 69).

raw:
I based these on the 100 measured edits and on how NAS-Bench-201 cells usually behave. Five patterns stand out:

- **Input-to-output residual (edge 3).** Adding a skip connection on edge 3 helps a lot when edge 3 is currently `none` (+3 to +49 points in experiments 61 and 91). Removing an existing skip there costs a lot (−2 to −17 in experiments 12, 72 and 82).
- **Single paths are fragile.** When edge 3 is `none`, cutting edge 0 or edge 5 can disconnect the cell. Accuracy then collapses to near chance (about −74 points on CIFAR-10 in experiments 64 and 65).
- **Replacing a weak op with a conv helps more.** Swapping `avg_pool_3x3` or `skip_connect` for `nor_conv_3x3` gains far more than swapping for `nor_conv_1x1` or `none`. The all-avg_pool and all-skip parents gained +30 to +45 points.
- **Avg-pool where a conv was is costly.** Putting `avg_pool_3x3` on edge 5 or edge 1 hurts more when it replaces a 3x3 conv on an important path.
- **Some evidence is thin.** Hypotheses 4, 7 and 10 below each rest on only one or two parent types.
